description: Today's base rates in South Korean won (KRW per unit) for about 43 currencies, from public official sources only: Export-Import Bank of Korea and Bank of Korea (ECOS). Posted on Korean business days around 11:00 KST; on weekends and public holidays the last posting is returned with is_past=true and next_update_kst. Each rate includes the currency name, change from the previous posting, one-week change and 30-day high/low. Indicative, not for transactions. Each result includes the source page URL and an attribution line.

currencies.description: ISO codes like USD, JPY, EUR. Empty = all available.

currency.description: One ISO code (USD) or several separated by commas (USD,JPY,EUR).
